notes: Discrete tapered amplifier (TA, Fig. 4) used as the power amplifier after the RWGSOA preamplifier, lens-coupled in a free-space bench-top chain. Input aperture 3 um, output aperture 200 um (p.6; no registry parameter names which width is which for a taper, kept here). Maker not stated (the acknowledgment credits Sarnoff only for the IBTSOA and RWGSOA): fab empty. Material only from the p.2 sentence on the cascaded InGaAs SOAs (preamplifier and TA); substrate not stated: platform empty (D422 / D423). The 16 mW input is the power delivered by the preamplifier (1 mm 5 deg tilted ridge-waveguide InGaAs/AlGaAs SOA at 150 mA, saturated by ~1.3 mW of stretched pulses, p.5-6) after an optical isolator and a band-pass filter (Fig. 4); the preamplifier is not a row (no value of that SOA by itself; D706). The 1 W corresponds to 10.5 nJ per 9.6 ns stretched pulse (p.6; pulse_energy_nj is not a registry parameter). Most, not all, of the 1 W is amplified signal (p.6, Fig. 5(d)); the ASE share is not quantified.
